source.extraction: Actual font glyph outlines extracted using fontTools SVGPathPen; affine layout transform only. No hand-drawn glyph paths.

morph.method: Matched, arc-length-resampled real font contours. Missing counters collapse to a zero-area point. Interpolate each point component and serialize each contour with M/L/Z. Use fill-rule=evenodd to preserve counters. Exact original quadratic outlines are in words[*].d.
